events.description: Draw a smooth closed loop on screen and place four colored dots on it.
events.clip_query: A smooth closed loop is drawn on screen with four colored dots placed on it

events.description: Connect the four dots with dynamic lines to form an inscribed quadrilateral.
events.clip_query: Lines connect the four dots on the loop to form a dynamic quadrilateral

events.description: Animate the dots sliding along the loop, dynamically updating the inscribed shape.
events.clip_query: The four dots slide along the closed loop, changing the shape of the inscribed quadrilateral

events.description: The dots settle into a configuration forming a perfect rectangle, which is highlighted.
events.clip_query: The dots stop at positions forming a perfect rectangle, which glows or changes color to highlight the solution
